svg.title: An illustrative house call
svg.desc: Illustrative exchange: the user says the PC takes three minutes to boot. Claude reads the boot log (read-only), names a first hypothesis, asks permission to disable one startup app, and the measured boot time goes from 170 to 42 seconds.

g.text: My PC takes three minutes to boot since last week.
Let's find what changed. First, I'd like to read Windows' own boot log.
It changes nothing on your PC.
Your boots went from about 40 s to about 170 s since Tuesday.
First hypothesis: a vendor update helper installed that day.
Nothing else is ruled out yet.
Next step, if you agree: disable it in Startup apps.
It's reversible and uninstalls nothing. May I walk you through it?
How to undo: re-enable it in Task Manager > Startup apps
